decisions.thought: Plan: Gholdengo absorbs Rotom-Wash's likely Will-O-Wisp (Good as Gold). Then Trick the scarf onto Rotom or Shadow Ball it; Make It Rain is 4x resisted by Rotom. decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Since Garchomp has Levitate's counterpart irrelevant here, I'm thinking Rotom-Wash's Will-O-Wisp would cripple Garchomp's physical damage, while its Hydro Pump hits neutrally since Water is resisted by Dragon but neutral against Ground.

Weighing options: Mega Garchomp's Dragon Claw does moderate damage but leaves it open to WoW, whereas switching to Gholdengo lets Make It Rain get resisted and Shadow Ball still chip away, plus Trick could lock Rotom out of status moves. I'm leaning toward bringing in Gholdengo to absorb the burn risk, accepting that Hydro Pump will land neutrally, while expecting Rotom to possibly just Volt Switch out instead.
